name: creative
label: Creative
css: .style-creative { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Bangers', cursive; } .style-creative::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-creative .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-creative .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-creative .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; margin: 0; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .style-creative .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); margin: 0; z-index: 2; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-code.style-creative { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); } .slide-code.style-creative .hook, .slide-code.style-creative .text, .slide-code.style-creative .brand { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-creative .step { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-code.style-creative::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-creative { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E293B 100%); position: relative; } .slide-insight.style-creative .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-creative .text { color: #E2E8F0; } .slide-insight.style-creative .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #3B82F6); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-creative .brand { color: #94A3B8; } .slide-insight.style-creative .insight-text { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: #F1F5F9; line-height: 1.4; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; margin: 0; }
